card.name: Linking words in speed and distance phrasing
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, per, of, and, or the s in m/s, just before or inside a speed or distance expression. Seen in physics problems, astronomy text and travel directions.

modes.label: Speed units
modes.description: The word per or s in a rate unit such as km per second or m/s.
modes.example: at speeds of over 1,000 kilometers<< per>> second.

modes.label: Words before speed or weight terms
modes.description: The, of or it right before a speed or physical quantity in physics problems.
modes.example: what is<< the>> weight of the book?

modes.label: Distance directions
modes.description: A verb or linker after a distance measure, in travel directions or in measuring footprints.
modes.example: about 500 meters northeast in the direction of Balaju.<< Turn>> left at the small village called Bara

card.writes: It seems to suppress length and distance words such as distance, lengths and 长度, so a speed or distance word is less likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in sentences about speed, distance or motion, such as the 'per' in 'kilometers per second'.
